We don’t want to name-drop again, so let’s just say a “major big-box retailer” recently made a serious commitment to plastic replacement by adopting EnduraGrip® and Cluster-Clip® multipack clip solutions to group together products like cocktail mix, cooking oil, and sauces in jars. The switch was a great success, and consumers are often surprised by how secure and durable the paperboard options are. Many pick up products gently, assuming they might break, until they realize they can handle bundled products in the same way as they previously did. [...] CanCollar packaging

### 1. Paper-based beverage collars (replaces plastic beverage rings)

When a Coca-Cola bottler does it, that says something. Major soda and beer brands like them are replacing plastic six-pack rings with options made from paperboard, like CanCollar®, PETCollar® and TopClip®. These options are recyclable where local recycling facilities recover polycoated and wet-strength-treated paperboard. \Brands that made the switch reduced their yearly plastic use by tons. The paperboard solutions are also customizable, so beverage makers can add branding or package beverages in any color they choose, helping their six-packs to be more eye-catching and attention-grabbing from the shelf.
